title: For loops
syllabusDesc: Iterate over sequences or ranges to repeat work.
desc:
A for loop lets you repeat a block of code for each item in a sequence such as a list, string, or range.

You use for loops when you know how many times an operation should run or when processing each element in a collection.

For loops make code predictable, readable, and easier to maintain.
techniques: Iterating over lists, strings, and ranges
challenges: Print all even numbers from 1 to 50
Sum all numbers in a list
Count how many times a value appears in a list
Reverse a string using a loop
Create a multiplication table using nested loops
Find the largest number in a list
Skip numbers divisible by 3 using continue
notes:
Avoid modifying a list while iterating over it.

If a loop becomes complex, consider breaking it into smaller steps or using helper functions.

For many cases, Python list comprehensions can replace simple loops for cleaner code.
